about: Proof that the LTX-2.3 style-transition LoRA (ltx2.3-transition.safetensors) runs on LTX-2.5 22B distilled int8 in workflows/ltx25_transition_api.json. Clip A is the same-clip source (day); clip B is its day-to-night take. The output is A, a 49-frame bridge from A's last frame to B's first frame, then B: 291 frames at 960x544.
verdict: Works. The bridge is continuous at both seams, the person stays whole and keeps her clothes, and the light moves from afternoon to moonlit night. Not tested: a run without the LoRA, so how much the LoRA adds over plain first and last frame guidance is not measured.

renders.name: transition_day_night
renders.prompt: The woman in the red coat walks down the cobblestone street while the sunny afternoon turns into a moonlit night, the lamps come on one by one
